target.title: feat(android): manage skills from settings
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Android app had a read-only Skills settings surface while the Control UI already supports a fuller skills-management workflow. Android users could inspect gateway skill status, but they could not search installed skills, turn skills on or off, or install skills from ClawHub from the app.

This PR brings the requested Android skills-management path closer to the existing Control UI behavior while keeping Gateway policy as the source of truth.

## Summary

- Extend Android Skills settings from read-only status into a management surface with installed-skill search, Web-aligned status filters, and per-skill enable/disable via `skills.update`.
- Add ClawHub registry search and install from Android via `skills.search` / `skills.install`.
- Align ClawHub install trust flow with the Control UI implementation: Android first calls `skills.install` without `acknowledgeClawHubRisk`, then shows an “Acknowledge risk and install” action only when the Gateway returns `clawhub_risk_acknowledgement_required`.
- Parse `blockedByAgentFilter` for accurate Android skills status and keep the Android README surface list current.

## Web UI Reference Checked

Reviewed the existing Control UI skills implementation in:

- `ui/src/pages/skills/view.ts`
- `ui/src/pages/skills/skills-page.ts`
- `ui/src/lib/skills/index.ts`

Android now mirrors the relevant requested behaviors from the Web UI: installed-skill filtering/status grouping, global enable/disable, ClawHub search/install, and risk-acknowledgement install retry behavior.

## Evidence

- Local: `git diff --check` passed.
- Local: `pnpm native:i18n:check` passed after syncing native app i18n inventory.
- Static review: no likely Kotlin compile issues were found in the Android changes before the Web-alignment follow-up.
- GitHub Actions, latest rebased CI run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28896380003 passed, including:
  - `android-test-play`
  - `android-test-third-party`
  - `android-ktlint`
  - `android-build-play`
  - `native-i18n`
- GitHub Actions, latest head Real behavior proof run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28896378915 passed.

## Risk Notes

- ClawHub install remains routed through the Gateway `skills.install` policy; Android only acknowledges risky installs after Gateway asks for explicit acknowledgement.
- The Android toggle changes the global skill enabled state. Agent allowlist/filter state is shown accurately but not edited by this PR.
- Local Gradle/ktlint/build was not run because the local environment has no Java runtime available; Android validation is covered by GitHub Actions.
